# Ruuts — Premium Chinese Tea Experiences & Rituals

> Reconnecting with roots through traditional Chinese tea culture, sensory rituals, and curated group gatherings in Shanghai, China.

## Entity & Brand Identity
- **Brand Name**: Ruuts (The Ruuts / RUUTS)
- **Website & Canonical Domain**: https://theruuts.com
- **Core Mission**: Reconnecting with authentic roots through Chinese tea exploration, celebrating intercultural connections across East and West, and collecting meaningful human moments and shared laughter around the tea table.
- **Key Philosophy Quote**: "Taking one’s time is the best way for not wasting it." — Nicolas Bouvier

## Founder & Tea Master
- **Name**: Ophélie Hu
- **Background**: Franco-Chinese heritage, Master's Degree in Supply Chain Management. Relocated to Shanghai, China in 2018.
- **Expertise & Certifications**: Transitioned into full-time tea mastery in 2021. Created the *Chabutu (茶不土)* WeChat community in 2022. Certified in Chinese Tea Tasting in Hangzhou (2024).
- **Specializations**: Terroir sourcing, sensory evaluation of oxidized and unoxidized teas, traditional Gongfu Cha (功夫茶) brewing, and multi-sensory artistic collaborations.

## Tea Terroir & Sourcing Provinces
Ruuts directly connects with local tea farmers and artisanal producers across six historically celebrated Chinese tea provinces:
- **Guangdong**: Renowned for Dancong Oolongs (Guangdong Oolong) with intense floral and fruity aromatics.
- **Yunnan**: Birthplace of ancient tea trees, Pu-erh (raw and ripe), and rich Dianhong black teas.
- **Fujian**: Home of Wuyi Rock Teas (Yan Cha), Anxi Tieguanyin, and Fuding White Teas.
- **Anhui**: Famous for Huangshan Maofeng green tea and Keemun black tea.
- **Zhejiang**: Origin of the legendary West Lake Longjing (Dragon Well) green tea.
- **Jiangsu**: Known for delicate Dongting Biluochun green tea.

## Core Experience Collections
### 1. Private B2C Experiences
- **Discovery Experiences**: Accessible, guided introductions to Chinese tea categories, brewing fundamentals, and sensory evaluation. Ideal for newcomers and curious tea enthusiasts.
- **Signature Collections**: Deep-dive cultural explorations focusing on rare vintages, specific provincial terroirs, live Guzheng/Pipa musical collaborations, and mindful Taichi pairing sessions.
- **Body Rituals**: Immersive, holistic gatherings combining traditional Chinese tea ceremonies with body awareness, breathwork, and sensory mindfulness.
- **Blind Tea Tastings**: Interactive sensory challenges where guests blindly evaluate aroma profiles, liquor textures, and lingering sweetness across distinct tea families.

### 2. Custom & B2B Corporate Experiences
- Tailored private cultural events, executive team hosting, corporate wellness sessions, and bespoke tea gifting collections designed for organizations and professional groups in Shanghai.
